name: 48103 · Ann Arbor, MI
findings: ZIP 48103 (Ann Arbor) has 332 nonprofit organizations. 146 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 117 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48103 (Ann Arbor) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48103 (Ann Arbor) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.2 times the typical level).
